8.3 Comment about rounding
Two types of rounding can be applied: Results are ’rounded off’, it means:
• 0 <= X < 0.5 rounded to 0
• 0.5 <= X < 1 rounded to 1
• -0.5 < X <= 0 rounded to 0
• -1 < X <= -0.5 rounded to -1 Results are rounded towards zero.
• 0 <= X < 1 rounded to 0
• -1 < X <= 0 rounded to 0

targets.why: Explains rounding off and half-way conventions.
